title: Comic Graffiti Seamless Digital Paper
author: BellinnaCraft
description:
This is a set of 12 Comic Graffiti Seamless Digital Paper, Graffiti Patterns, Street Art Backgrounds, Urban Pop Art Digital Scrapbook Paper, Graffiti Background.
Bring bold street vibes into your creative projects with this Comic Graffiti Digital Paper Collection!
This set includes 12 seamless graffiti patterns inspired by urban street art, comic book style lettering, and vibrant pop art illustrations. Perfect for adding an edgy and playful look to your designs!
These backgrounds are great for:
Scrapbooking and journaling
Invitations and party decorations
Sublimation and print-on-demand designs
Stickers, planners, and card making
Digital projects and DIY crafts
👉 Details:
12 seamless patterns
Size: 12 x 12 inches (3600 x 3600 px)
High resolution: 300 DPI, JPEG format
Instant digital download (no physical product will be shipped)
✨ Add a splash of color, energy, and comic-style fun to your projects with these graffiti seamless backgrounds!
